articles.title: Houthi Authorities Report Thirty Fatalities from Market Bombardment
articles.summary: According to Houthi officials, multiple aerial attacks struck a marketplace in the Taiz region. The targeted territory is under Houthi control and has experienced intense combat since autumn.

articles.origSummary: The Houthis said "several strikes" hit the market in an area under their control in Taiz province, the scene of fierce fighting since the Iran-backed group launched a major offensive in September.

articles.title: Marco Rubio Heads to Paris G7 Meeting After Midterm Losses
articles.summary: Following heavy Republican defeats in the US midterms that gave Democrats control of Congress, Marco Rubio is taking his first post-election international trip to the G7 talks.
articles.origTitle: Marco Rubio To Attend Paris G7 Talks Next Week After US Midterms Setback
articles.origSummary: This marks Rubio's first trip abroad since the Republican Party's sweeping losses in US midterm elections, dealing a sharp blow to President Donald Trump as Democrats won full control of Congress.

articles.title: Pope Leo Begins South American Tour Following Lung Surgery
articles.summary: Following lung cancer surgery last month, Pope Leo XIV stated he feels relatively well. He made the remarks on Friday at the start of a 12-day trip to South America, beginning in Uruguay.
articles.origTitle: Pope Leo Says In "Fairly Good Shape" After Lung Cancer Surgery
articles.origSummary: Pope Leo XIV said Friday he was in "fairly good shape" after lung cancer surgery last month as he began a 12-day tour of South America with a visit to Uruguay.

articles.title: Trump appoints Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff following defeat
articles.summary: Following a midterm defeat, Donald Trump named Stephen Miller as his incoming Chief of Staff. Miller succeeds Susie Wiles, who made history as the initial female appointee to the position.
articles.origTitle: After Midterm Rout, Trump Announces Stephen Miller As New Chief Of Staff
articles.origSummary: Susie Wiles, the outgoing Chief of Staff, was Trump's first appointee after the 2024 election, and she made history as the first woman to hold the post of White House Chief of Staff.

articles.origTitle: Trump Participates In Diwali Celebration At White House
articles.origSummary: India's Ambassador to the US Vinay Kwatra was among those present at the Oval Office for the celebration. The tradition of having a Diwali celebration was started by President George W Bush in 2003.

articles.title: Trump criticizes immigration chief after concerns from Melania

articles.origSummary: According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, Melania told her husband that people she knew were being deported as part of his sweeping anti-immigration campaign.
